package probe

import "os/exec"

// The command was aliased before its Env is assigned again: the assignment is
// a finding whatever its value, an accepted value included.
func envAfterAlias() error {
	cmd := exec.Command("sh")
	cmd.Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin"}
	other := cmd
	_ = other
	cmd.Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin"}
	return cmd.Run()
}
